newsitem.title: SPAIN: Croatia Airlines starts Madrid-zagreb service.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Airlines starts Madrid-zagreb service.

text.p: Croatia Airlines launched its first scheduled service to Spain on Thursday when it started a twice weekly Madrid-Zagreb flight, a spokeswoman for the airline said.
It will use an Airbus A320 and a Boeing 737-200 on the route and expects to attract cargo business between the two countries, she said, without giving more details.

The Spanish state-owned airline Iberia Lineas Aereas de Espana SA does not fly to Zagreb. However Croatia Airlines is negotiating a code sharing agreement with Iberia which should come into force this summer. This would mean passengers would book seats as if the Croatian flight were an Iberia service and should help boost sales within Spain. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
